blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 學完本節後，您能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 說明風險評估如何決定PQ取樣範圍與頻率。
blocks.en: Explain how risk assessment determines the scope and frequency of PQ sampling.

blocks.zh: 閱讀表2.2，規劃源水及前處理設備的測試計畫。
blocks.en: Read Table 2.2 and plan a test program for source water and pretreatment equipment.

blocks.zh: 使用表2.3和2.4，為PW/WFI配送系統建立四階段取樣時程。
blocks.en: Use Tables 2.3 and 2.4 to build a four-phase sampling schedule for PW/WFI distribution systems.

blocks.zh: 區分關鍵與非關鍵用水點，並套用正確的頻率層級。
blocks.en: Distinguish critical from non-critical points of use and apply the correct frequency tier.

blocks.zh: 解釋為何WFI需增加內毒素測試，而PW不一定需要。
blocks.en: Explain why WFI requires additional endotoxin testing while PW does not necessarily need it.

blocks.zh: 以延長期頻率作為持續監測的基準。
blocks.en: Use the extended-phase frequency as the baseline for ongoing monitoring.

blocks.zh: 以風險為基礎的確效取樣方法
blocks.en: A Risk-Based Approach to Validation Sampling

blocks.zh: 中文解說與應用
blocks.en: Commentary and Application

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風險導向取樣 Risk-Based Sampling
blocks.en: Core Concept: Risk-Based Sampling

blocks.zh: ISPE的出發點非常清楚：取樣不是越多越好，而是要精準。風險評估決定三件事：
blocks.en: ISPE's starting point is very clear: more sampling is not better; precise sampling is better. Risk assessment decides three things:

blocks.zh: 在哪裡取樣（哪些點位）
blocks.en: Where to sample (which points)

blocks.zh: 測什麼（哪些屬性）
blocks.en: What to test (which attributes)

blocks.zh: 多久測一次（頻率）
blocks.en: How often to test (frequency)

blocks.zh: 這三者都必須有書面的風險理由，而非慣例或直觀。
blocks.en: All three must have a documented risk rationale, not rely on habit or intuition.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院急診分流
blocks.en: Analogy: Emergency Room Triage

blocks.zh: 急診室的護理師不對每位病人做全套檢查，而是先評估風險等級（triage），再決定要做哪些檢查、多快要出結果。製藥用水的PQ取樣邏輯完全相同：先評風險，再定頻率。
blocks.en: An emergency room nurse does not run a full set of tests on every patient. The nurse first assesses the risk level (triage), then decides which tests are needed and how fast results are required. The logic of PQ sampling for pharmaceutical water is exactly the same: assess the risk first, then set the frequency.

blocks.zh:
關鍵用水點（直接接觸產品）= 重症病人 → 每日監測
非關鍵用水點（預清洗用水）= 輕症病人 → 可以降低頻率
blocks.en:
Critical point of use (direct product contact) = critically ill patient → monitor daily
Non-critical point of use (pre-wash water) = mild case → frequency can be reduced

blocks.zh: 監管重點：PQ最短一年
blocks.en: Regulatory Focus: PQ Lasts at Least One Year

blocks.zh: FDA 1993年《高純度水系統檢查指南》明確要求PQ總時長不得少於一年。這是跨越四季的要求，因為：
blocks.en: The FDA 1993 "Guide to Inspections of High Purity Water Systems" explicitly requires a total PQ duration of no less than one year. This requirement spans all four seasons because:

blocks.zh: 夏季高溫 → 微生物風險上升
blocks.en: Hot summer → higher microbial risk

blocks.zh: 冬季低溫 → 源水水質變化
blocks.en: Cold winter → changes in source water quality

blocks.zh: 雨季 → 源水有機物、內毒素負荷增加
blocks.en: Rainy season → higher organic and endotoxin load in source water

blocks.zh: 不到一年的PQ，在稽查時會被直接質疑。
blocks.en: A PQ shorter than one year will be challenged directly during an inspection.

blocks.zh: CDMO應用：風險評估文件的結構
blocks.en: CDMO Application: Structure of the Risk Assessment Document

blocks.zh: 在CDMO情境下，一份好的PQ風險評估文件應包含：
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, a good PQ risk assessment document should include:

blocks.zh: 系統描述：PW或WFI，系統規模，用水點數量
blocks.en: System description: PW or WFI, system size, number of points of use

blocks.zh: 風險評分矩陣：每個用水點的嚴重度×發生率×可偵測性
blocks.en: Risk scoring matrix: severity × occurrence × detectability for each point of use

blocks.zh: 取樣計畫摘要表：點位 × 屬性 × 四個PQ階段頻率
blocks.en: Sampling plan summary table: point × attribute × frequency in each of the four PQ phases

blocks.zh: 偏差決策邏輯：何時觸發OOS調查，何時暫停PQ
blocks.en: Deviation decision logic: when to trigger an OOS investigation and when to pause PQ

blocks.zh: 思考練習 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 您的工廠有一套WFI系統，共18個用水點，其中3個用於最終淋洗，其餘用於配製清潔劑。如何使用風險評估，將這18個點分為不同的取樣頻率層級？
blocks.en: Your facility has a WFI system with 18 points of use, 3 of which are used for final rinse and the rest for detergent preparation. How would you use risk assessment to divide these 18 points into different sampling frequency tiers?

blocks.zh: 試舉出三個可能讓您縮短PQ初始階段的條件，並說明各自的風險理由。
blocks.en: Give three conditions that could justify shortening the initial PQ phase, and explain the risk rationale for each.

blocks.zh: 如果源水（市政自來水）在夏季曾出現高菌數，這個歷史數據應如何影響您的PQ取樣計畫？
blocks.en: If the source water (municipal tap water) has shown high microbial counts in summer, how should this historical data influence your PQ sampling plan?

blocks.en: Validation Sampling: Overview of the Four-Phase Framework

blocks.en: The Four Phases in Detail

blocks.zh: 頻率遞減原則
blocks.en: Principle of Decreasing Frequency

blocks.zh: 四個階段的取樣頻率呈現「漏斗型」遞減：
blocks.en: Sampling frequency across the four phases follows a "funnel-shaped" decline:

blocks.zh: 試車期：確認，通常是一次性全面測試
blocks.en: Commissioning phase: confirmation, usually a one-time comprehensive test

blocks.zh: 初始期：最高頻率，每日取樣，累積基準數據
blocks.en: Initial phase: highest frequency, daily sampling, to build baseline data

blocks.zh: 中間期：頻率降至每日至每週之間
blocks.en: Intermediate phase: frequency reduced to between daily and weekly

blocks.zh: 延長期：降至每週或更低，成為日常監測頻率
blocks.en: Extended phase: reduced to weekly or lower, becoming the routine monitoring frequency

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：只有當數據持續穩定才能降頻，不能一開始就跳過高頻率階段。
blocks.en: Key principle: frequency may be reduced only when the data remain consistently stable; you cannot skip the high-frequency phases from the start.

blocks.zh: 比喻：新員工試用期
blocks.en: Analogy: A New Employee's Probation Period

blocks.zh: 一位新進員工：
blocks.en: For a new employee:

blocks.zh: 第一個月（初始期）→ 主管每天確認工作品質
blocks.en: Month 1 (initial phase) → the manager checks work quality every day

blocks.zh: 第二至三個月（中間期）→ 每週確認
blocks.en: Months 2 to 3 (intermediate phase) → weekly checks

blocks.zh: 轉正後（延長期）→ 每月或每季考核
blocks.en: After confirmation (extended phase) → monthly or quarterly reviews

blocks.zh: 水系統PQ邏輯完全相同。表現好的系統，稽查頻率自然可以降低，但必須有數據支持。
blocks.en: Water system PQ follows exactly the same logic. A system that performs well can naturally be checked less often, but the data must support it.

blocks.zh: 延長期 = 日常監測起點
blocks.en: Extended Phase = Starting Point for Routine Monitoring

blocks.zh: 注意事項（Note B，見表2.3與2.4）：延長期的取樣頻率和範圍，通常成為未來例行性驗證維護測試的初始頻率，但可根據累積數據和風險分析進行調整。
blocks.en: Note B (see Tables 2.3 and 2.4): the sampling frequency and scope of the extended phase usually become the initial frequency for future routine validation maintenance testing, but may be adjusted based on accumulated data and risk analysis.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：做PQ的目標之一，就是用12個月的數據來科學地確定「最小但足夠的」日常監測頻率。
blocks.en: This means that one goal of PQ is to use 12 months of data to scientifically establish the "minimum but sufficient" routine monitoring frequency.

blocks.zh: 如果您的PQ初始期數據非常穩定（所有指標都遠低於Alert Level），您能否縮短中間期的時長？需要哪些文件支持此決定？
blocks.en: If your PQ initial-phase data are very stable (all parameters well below the Alert Level), can you shorten the intermediate phase? What documentation is needed to support that decision?

blocks.zh: 試解釋為什麼「試車期（Commissioning）」的數據雖然不屬於正式PQ，但對PQ計畫仍然很重要。
blocks.en: Explain why data from the commissioning phase, although not part of the formal PQ, are still important to the PQ plan.

blocks.zh: 一套PW系統的延長期取樣頻率定為「TOC每週一次，微生物每兩週一次」。這套頻率需要哪些條件才能在稽查時站得住腳？
blocks.en: The extended-phase sampling frequency for a PW system is set at "TOC weekly, microbial counts every two weeks". What conditions must be met for this frequency to be defensible in an inspection?

blocks.zh: 表2.2 — 源水及前處理設備測試頻率示例
blocks.en: Table 2.2 — Example Test Frequencies for Source Water and Pretreatment Equipment

blocks.zh: How to Read This Table 如何閱讀本表
blocks.en: How to Read This Table

blocks.zh: 閱讀方式：橫軸為四個PQ階段（試車→初始→中間→延長），縱軸為各取樣點（源水→軟化器→活性炭→薄膜過濾→UV→RO→CEDI→儲水），交叉點即為「該點在該階段應測的屬性與頻率」。
blocks.en: How to read it: the horizontal axis shows the four PQ phases (commissioning → initial → intermediate → extended), and the vertical axis shows the sampling points (source water → softener → activated carbon → membrane filtration → UV → RO → CEDI → storage tank). Each intersection gives "the attributes and frequency to be tested at that point in that phase".

blocks.zh: 中文解說：如何應用表2.2
blocks.en: Commentary: How to Apply Table 2.2

blocks.zh: 表2.2的結構邏輯
blocks.en: Logic of the Structure of Table 2.2

blocks.zh: 表2.2從源水一路追蹤到儲水槽出口，涵蓋每個前處理單元。設計這張表的邏輯是：
blocks.en: Table 2.2 follows the water from the source water all the way to the storage tank outlet, covering every pretreatment unit. The logic behind the table is:

blocks.zh: 每個單元操作都有其關鍵功能（例如：RO的功能是去除離子和有機物）
blocks.en: Each unit operation has its own critical function (for example, the function of RO is to remove ions and organics)

blocks.zh: PQ測試要驗證該功能在整個確效期間持續有效
blocks.en: PQ testing verifies that this function remains effective throughout the validation period

blocks.zh: 測試的屬性直接對應該單元的功能（例如：碳過濾器出口測氯殘留）
blocks.en: The attributes tested correspond directly to the unit's function (for example, residual chlorine is tested at the carbon filter outlet)

blocks.zh: 比喻：水質淨化流水線
blocks.en: Analogy: A Water Purification Production Line

blocks.zh: 想像一條工廠生產線，每個工站（station）負責一個加工步驟。品管不是只在最後一站驗貨，而是在每個工站出口設定品質檢查點。
blocks.en: Imagine a factory production line in which each station performs one processing step. Quality control does not inspect only at the last station; it sets a quality checkpoint at the outlet of every station.

blocks.zh: 水系統的前處理設備就是這條「水質加工生產線」：源水→軟化→除氯→過濾→RO→CEDI→儲水。PQ就是在每個工站出口確認品質達標。
blocks.en: The pretreatment equipment of a water system is this "water processing line": source water → softening → dechlorination → filtration → RO → CEDI → storage. PQ confirms at the outlet of each station that quality meets the requirements.

blocks.zh: 各設備測試重點速查
blocks.en: Quick Reference: Test Focus by Equipment

blocks.zh: 源水：pH、氯、化學指標、微生物 — 追蹤市政供水季節性變化
blocks.en: Source water: pH, chlorine, chemical parameters, microbial counts — track seasonal changes in the municipal supply

blocks.zh: 軟化器：硬度（鈣鎂離子）— 確認交換樹脂效能
blocks.en: Softener: hardness (calcium and magnesium ions) — confirms exchange resin performance

blocks.zh: 活性炭過濾：氯殘留、TOC — 防止氯傷害下游RO膜
blocks.en: Activated carbon filtration: residual chlorine, TOC — prevents chlorine damage to downstream RO membranes

blocks.zh: 薄膜過濾：顆粒、壓差 — 完整性指標
blocks.en: Membrane filtration: particles, differential pressure — integrity indicators

blocks.zh: UV：微生物、UV強度 — 殺菌效果確認
blocks.en: UV: microbial counts, UV intensity — confirms disinfection effectiveness

blocks.zh: RO：電導率、TOC、去除率 — 核心純化步驟
blocks.en: RO: conductivity, TOC, rejection rate — the core purification step

blocks.zh: CEDI：電導率、電阻率 — 離子去除效果
blocks.en: CEDI: conductivity, resistivity — ion removal performance

blocks.zh: 儲水槽：全套藥典規格 — 最終PW品質確認
blocks.en: Storage tank: full pharmacopoeial specification — final confirmation of PW quality

blocks.zh: CDMO稽查應對：前處理設備取樣的常見查核點
blocks.en: CDMO Audit Readiness: Common Check Points for Pretreatment Sampling

blocks.zh: 稽查官常問：「你的RO設備確效期間每日測哪些指標？」→ 要能直接報出清單
blocks.en: Auditors often ask: "Which parameters do you test daily on your RO unit during validation?" → be ready to state the list immediately

blocks.zh: 「你的碳過濾器出口氯殘留數據在PQ延長期是多少？」→ 要有趨勢圖
blocks.en: "What were your carbon filter outlet residual chlorine results in the extended PQ phase?" → have a trend chart

blocks.zh: 「如果源水夏季大腸桿菌群上升，你的取樣頻率如何應對？」→ 要有書面程序
blocks.en: "If coliform counts in the source water rise in summer, how does your sampling frequency respond?" → have a written procedure

blocks.zh: 您工廠的RO系統在PQ初始期第5天出現電導率異常上升（接近Alert Level）。依據表2.2的邏輯，您應該：(a)繼續每日取樣，(b)增加取樣頻率，(c)暫停PQ？請說明理由。
blocks.en: On day 5 of the PQ initial phase, the conductivity of your RO system rises abnormally (approaching the Alert Level). Based on the logic of Table 2.2, should you: (a) continue daily sampling, (b) increase the sampling frequency, or (c) pause PQ? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 為什麼CEDI設備要同時測「電導率」和「電阻率」？這兩個指標各代表什麼？
blocks.en: Why should a CEDI unit be tested for both "conductivity" and "resistivity"? What does each parameter represent?

blocks.zh: 活性炭過濾器在什麼情況下可能導致微生物數量升高，而非降低？這對您的取樣計畫有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances can an activated carbon filter cause microbial counts to rise rather than fall? What does this mean for your sampling plan?

blocks.zh: 表2.3 — 純化水配送系統取樣頻率
blocks.en: Table 2.3 — Sampling Frequency for Purified Water Distribution Systems

blocks.zh: Context 背景說明
blocks.en: Context

blocks.zh: 本表涵蓋PW配送迴路的五個典型取樣位置，從配送泵出口到迴路末端。位置不同，風險不同，測試頻率也不同。
blocks.en: This table covers five typical sampling locations in a PW distribution loop, from the distribution pump outlet to the end of the loop. Different locations carry different risks and therefore different test frequencies.

blocks.zh: 中文解說：表2.3深度解析
blocks.en: Commentary: In-Depth Analysis of Table 2.3

blocks.zh: 五個取樣位置的意義
blocks.en: What the Five Sampling Locations Mean

blocks.zh: 配送泵出口：代表「離開純化區，進入配送迴路之前」的水質 — 是整個配送系統的品質起點
blocks.en: Distribution pump outlet: represents water "leaving the purification area and before entering the distribution loop" — the quality starting point of the whole distribution system

blocks.zh: 迴路起始點/第一用水點後：確認水質在進入迴路後是否立即受到影響
blocks.en: Loop start / after the first point of use: confirms whether water quality is affected immediately after entering the loop

blocks.zh: 關鍵用水點（CUP）：直接接觸產品/配方成分/最終淋洗 → 最高風險，頻率最高
blocks.en: Critical point of use (CUP): direct product contact / ingredient water / final rinse → highest risk, highest frequency

blocks.zh: 非關鍵用水點（NCUP）：預清洗、非產品接觸 → 風險較低，延長期可降至每月一次
blocks.en: Non-critical point of use (NCUP): pre-wash, non-product contact → lower risk; in the extended phase can be reduced to once a month

blocks.zh: 迴路末端/最後POU：最遠點，水在迴路中停留時間最長，微生物風險最高 → 需額外確認流量、溫度、壓力
blocks.en: End of loop / last POU: the furthest point, where water has the longest residence time in the loop and microbial risk is highest → flow, temperature and pressure need additional confirmation

blocks.zh: 比喻：城市供水管網的水質監測
blocks.en: Analogy: Water Quality Monitoring in a City Supply Network

blocks.zh: 城市自來水公司不會對每一個水龍頭都每天取樣，而是：
blocks.en: A city water utility does not sample every tap every day. Instead:

blocks.zh: 幹管出口 → 最高頻率
blocks.en: Main pipe outlet → highest frequency

blocks.zh: 學校、醫院取水點 → 高頻（關鍵使用者）
blocks.en: Schools and hospital taps → high frequency (critical users)

blocks.zh: 一般住宅 → 定期抽查（非關鍵）
blocks.en: Ordinary homes → periodic spot checks (non-critical)

blocks.zh: 管網末端 → 特別關注（最遠點，水齡最長）
blocks.en: End of the network → special attention (furthest point, longest water age)

blocks.zh: 製藥PW配送迴路的邏輯與此完全一致。
blocks.en: The logic of a pharmaceutical PW distribution loop is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 在線監測（On-line）的應用條件
blocks.en: Conditions for Using On-line Monitoring

blocks.zh: 表2.3多處提到「on-line」選項，但使用在線數據代替採樣有前提條件（Note D）：
blocks.en: Table 2.3 mentions an "on-line" option in several places, but using on-line data in place of sampling has preconditions (Note D):

blocks.zh: 必須驗證在線讀數與採樣結果的等效性
blocks.en: The equivalence of on-line readings and sample results must be verified

blocks.zh: 等效性驗證需在PQ階段完成，有書面記錄
blocks.en: The equivalence verification must be completed during the PQ phase and documented

blocks.zh: 只有在等效性確立後，在線數據才能用於產品放行目的
blocks.en: Only after equivalence is established can on-line data be used for product release purposes

blocks.zh: 若某用水點有局部污染風險（如POU熱交換器），仍需採樣，不能僅靠在線監測
blocks.en: If a point of use has a risk of local contamination (such as a POU heat exchanger), sampling is still required; on-line monitoring alone is not sufficient

blocks.zh: 迴路末端（Last POU/End of Loop）的特殊要求
blocks.en: Special Requirements for the End of Loop (Last POU)

blocks.zh: 表2.3對迴路末端有額外要求：除標準測試外，試車期還需確認物理屬性（流量、溫度、壓力），且要在URS定義的最小和最大用水情境下分別確認。
blocks.en: Table 2.3 adds requirements for the end of the loop: in addition to the standard tests, the commissioning phase must also confirm the physical attributes (flow, temperature, pressure), separately at the minimum and maximum demand scenarios defined in the URS.

blocks.zh: 為什麼？迴路末端是水在管路中停留時間最長的位置，也是系統水力設計的「壓力測試點」。確認最大用水量時各點仍有足夠流速（通常≥1 m/s），是防止細菌生物膜形成的關鍵。
blocks.en: Why? The end of the loop is where water has the longest residence time in the piping, and it is also the "stress test point" of the system's hydraulic design. Confirming that every point still has sufficient flow velocity (usually ≥1 m/s) at maximum water demand is key to preventing biofilm formation.

blocks.zh: 您的PW系統有12個用水點，其中5個為CUP，7個為NCUP。進入延長期後，每個月最少需要進行多少次微生物採樣？請計算並說明邏輯。
blocks.en: Your PW system has 12 points of use, 5 CUPs and 7 NCUPs. Once in the extended phase, what is the minimum number of microbial samples needed each month? Calculate it and explain your logic.

blocks.zh: 一個用水點原本被分類為NCUP（預清洗），但現在客戶要求改用此點進行最終淋洗。這個變更對PQ取樣計畫有什麼影響？需要哪些文件？
blocks.en: A point of use was originally classified as NCUP (pre-wash), but a customer now wants to use it for final rinse. What is the impact of this change on the PQ sampling plan? What documents are needed?

blocks.zh: 如果您的在線TOC監測系統在延長期出現3天故障，手動採樣如何填補？在線與採樣的等效性驗證應如何設計？
blocks.en: If your on-line TOC monitoring system fails for 3 days in the extended phase, how would manual sampling fill the gap? How should the equivalence verification between on-line and sampled results be designed?

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異：CUP vs NCUP在延長期的頻率
blocks.en: Key Difference: CUP vs NCUP Frequency in the Extended Phase

blocks.zh: 這個差異在中間期更明顯：CUP中間期最低每週，NCUP中間期可以降至每月。
blocks.en: This difference is even more pronounced in the intermediate phase: for CUPs the intermediate phase is at least weekly, while for NCUPs it can be reduced to monthly.

blocks.zh: 表2.4 — 注射用水（WFI）配送系統取樣頻率
blocks.en: Table 2.4 — Sampling Frequency for Water for Injection (WFI) Distribution Systems

blocks.zh: Key Difference from Table 2.3 / 與表2.3的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Difference from Table 2.3

blocks.zh: WFI用於注射劑和無菌設備最終淋洗，是最高風險等級的製藥用水。表2.4在所有WFI配送點增加「內毒素測試」，且關鍵用水點在中間期維持每日取樣（比PW要求更嚴格）。
blocks.en: WFI is used for injectables and for the final rinse of sterile equipment, and is the highest-risk grade of pharmaceutical water. Table 2.4 adds "endotoxin testing" at all WFI distribution points, and critical points of use remain on daily sampling in the intermediate phase (stricter than the PW requirement).

blocks.zh: 中文解說：WFI vs PW — 關鍵差異
blocks.en: Commentary: WFI vs PW — Key Differences

blocks.zh: WFI Note B：FDA 1993年的硬性要求
blocks.en: WFI Note B: A Firm FDA 1993 Requirement

blocks.zh: 表2.4 Note B明確引用FDA 1993年《高純度水系統檢查指南》：
blocks.en: Table 2.4 Note B explicitly cites the FDA 1993 "Guide to Inspections of High Purity Water Systems":

blocks.zh: 每日：至少一個POU必須採樣
blocks.en: Daily: at least one POU must be sampled

blocks.zh: 每週：所有POU都必須覆蓋
blocks.en: Weekly: all POUs must be covered

blocks.zh: 這是WFI系統的法規底線，不是建議。即使在延長期，每週仍需輪流覆蓋所有WFI用水點。這在稽查時會被直接查核取樣記錄。
blocks.en: This is the regulatory floor for WFI systems, not a recommendation. Even in the extended phase, all WFI points of use must still be covered on a weekly rotation. Sampling records are checked directly during inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻：WFI vs PW 如同加護病房 vs 普通病房
blocks.en: Analogy: WFI vs PW is Like ICU vs a General Ward

blocks.zh: 加護病房（WFI）：每日生命徵象監測，氧飽和度持續在線監測，不允許降頻。
blocks.en: ICU (WFI): daily vital-sign monitoring, continuous on-line oxygen saturation monitoring, no reduction in frequency allowed.

blocks.zh: 普通病房（PW）：視病情穩定度決定監測頻率，狀況好可降至每週。
blocks.en: General ward (PW): monitoring frequency depends on how stable the patient is; if the condition is good, it can be reduced to weekly.

blocks.zh: WFI的CUP在中間期「不降頻」，就像ICU病人即使穩定也不能降到普通病房的監測規格一樣——因為一旦出問題，直接影響患者（注射劑品質）。
blocks.en: WFI CUPs are "not reduced in frequency" in the intermediate phase, just as an ICU patient cannot be moved down to general-ward monitoring even when stable, because once a problem occurs, it directly affects the patient (injectable product quality).

blocks.zh: WFI系統內毒素 Alert/Action Level 設定原則
blocks.en: Principles for Setting Endotoxin Alert/Action Levels in WFI Systems

blocks.zh: USP/EP/JP WFI規格：≤0.25 EU/mL
blocks.en: USP/EP/JP WFI specification: ≤0.25 EU/mL

blocks.zh: Alert Level：通常設在0.125 EU/mL（規格限度的50%）
blocks.en: Alert Level: usually set at 0.125 EU/mL (50% of the specification limit)

blocks.zh: Action Level：通常設在規格限度，即0.25 EU/mL
blocks.en: Action Level: usually set at the specification limit, i.e. 0.25 EU/mL

blocks.zh: PQ期間的Alert/Action Level可能更嚴格，以確認系統正常趨勢
blocks.en: Alert/Action Levels during PQ may be stricter to confirm normal system trends

blocks.zh: 這些數值應在取樣計畫中明確定義，並在PQ報告中載明。
blocks.en: These values should be clearly defined in the sampling plan and stated in the PQ report.

blocks.zh: CDMO無菌填充廠的WFI取樣實務
blocks.en: WFI Sampling Practice at an Aseptic Fill-Finish CDMO

blocks.zh: 以一個有8個WFI用水點的aseptic fill-finish CDMO為例，延長期的最低合規取樣計畫：
blocks.en: Taking an aseptic fill-finish CDMO with 8 WFI points of use as an example, the minimum compliant sampling plan for the extended phase is:

blocks.zh: 每日：隨機指定1個POU（電導率、TOC、內毒素、微生物）
blocks.en: Daily: 1 randomly assigned POU (conductivity, TOC, endotoxin, microbial counts)

blocks.zh: 每週：覆蓋所有8個POU（分散在7天中取樣）
blocks.en: Weekly: cover all 8 POUs (spread over 7 days)

blocks.zh: 在線監測：電導率和TOC全天候，但需有等效性驗證
blocks.en: On-line monitoring: conductivity and TOC around the clock, but equivalence verification is required

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析：每月彙整Alert Level觸發次數，作為PSE輸入
blocks.en: Trend analysis: compile the number of Alert Level excursions monthly as input to the PSE

blocks.zh: 您的WFI系統有10個用水點：3個CUP（直接產品接觸）、5個用於設備清洗最終淋洗、2個用於清潔劑配製。如何分類這10個點，並規劃延長期的每週採樣輪換計畫？
blocks.en: Your WFI system has 10 points of use: 3 CUPs (direct product contact), 5 used for the final rinse of equipment cleaning, and 2 used for detergent preparation. How would you classify these 10 points and plan the weekly sampling rotation for the extended phase?

blocks.zh: WFI CUP在中間期需要維持每日採樣，但PW CUP可以降至每週。從科學上解釋這個差異的理由。如果有稽查官問你「為什麼PW不需要每日？」你如何回答？
blocks.en: WFI CUPs must remain on daily sampling in the intermediate phase, but PW CUPs can be reduced to weekly. Explain the scientific reasoning for this difference. If an auditor asks you "why doesn't PW need daily sampling?", how would you answer?

blocks.zh: 假設您的WFI系統在延長期第3個月，有一個CUP的內毒素結果達到0.20 EU/mL（Alert Level為0.125，Action Level為0.25）。觸發Alert Level後，您的取樣頻率和調查步驟是什麼？
blocks.en: Suppose that in month 3 of the extended phase, the endotoxin result at one CUP of your WFI system reaches 0.20 EU/mL (Alert Level 0.125, Action Level 0.25). After the Alert Level is triggered, what are your sampling frequency and investigation steps?

blocks.zh: WFI取樣與PW的三大差異
blocks.en: Three Major Differences Between WFI and PW Sampling

blocks.zh: 附注彙整與關鍵定義說明
blocks.en: Summary of Table Notes and Key Definitions

blocks.zh: 中文解說：附注的實務意義
blocks.en: Commentary: Practical Meaning of the Notes

blocks.zh: 「關鍵用水點」的法規定義邊界
blocks.en: Regulatory Boundaries of the "Critical Point of Use" Definition

blocks.zh: CUP的定義明確：成分用水、直接產品接觸、最終淋洗。實務上常見的爭議案例：
blocks.en: The definition of CUP is clear: ingredient water, direct product contact, final rinse. Commonly disputed cases in practice include:

blocks.zh: 配製緩衝液 → CUP（成分用水）
blocks.en: Buffer preparation → CUP (ingredient water)

blocks.zh: 設備最終淋洗 → CUP（最終淋洗）
blocks.en: Final rinse of equipment → CUP (final rinse)

blocks.zh: 設備預清洗 → NCUP（非最終接觸）
blocks.en: Pre-wash of equipment → NCUP (not final contact)

blocks.zh: 清潔劑配製 → NCUP（非直接產品接觸）
blocks.en: Detergent preparation → NCUP (no direct product contact)

blocks.zh: 廠房地板清潔 → NCUP
blocks.en: Facility floor cleaning → NCUP

blocks.zh: 邊界模糊的情況，應由QA書面決策，記錄在取樣計畫中。
blocks.en: Where the boundary is unclear, QA should make a documented decision and record it in the sampling plan.

blocks.zh: 微生物鑑定的「最小化」原則
blocks.en: The "Minimization" Principle for Microbial Identification

blocks.zh: Note E/F說明微生物鑑定只需對「外觀有差異」的菌落進行。這個原則有實務意義：
blocks.en: Notes E/F state that microbial identification is only needed for colonies that "look different". This principle has practical significance:

blocks.zh: 若POU A和POU B都出現同樣外觀的菌落，且A已鑑定為Ralstonia pickettii，B不需要再次鑑定
blocks.en: If POU A and POU B both show colonies of the same appearance, and A has been identified as Ralstonia pickettii, B does not need to be identified again

blocks.zh: 這減少了不必要的鑑定成本，但要有書面邏輯支持
blocks.en: This reduces unnecessary identification cost, but it must be supported by documented logic

blocks.zh: 稽查時，稽查官可能會查「為什麼這批菌落沒有鑑定到種」
blocks.en: During an audit, the auditor may ask "why were the colonies in this batch not identified to species level?"

blocks.zh: 比喻：化學測試「依藥典而定」
blocks.en: Analogy: Chemical Testing "According to the Pharmacopoeia"

blocks.zh: 就像出口商品要符合目的國的安全標準，不是世界上最嚴格的那個，而是「目的市場要求的那個」。
blocks.en: It is like export goods having to meet the safety standards of the destination country: not the strictest in the world, but "the one required by the target market".

blocks.zh:
出口美國的WFI → 依USP
出口歐盟的WFI → 依EP
出口日本的WFI → 依JP
blocks.en:
WFI exported to the US → per USP
WFI exported to the EU → per EP
WFI exported to Japan → per JP

blocks.zh: 如果同一批水同時出口美日歐，則取三者聯集（最嚴格的要求）。
blocks.en: If the same batch of water is exported to the US, Japan and Europe at the same time, take the union of the three (the strictest requirements).

blocks.zh: 「替代取樣點」的文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation Requirements for "Alternative Sampling Points"

blocks.zh: 某些POU在實際安裝後無法取樣（例如：閉式連接的一次性容器充填站）。ISPE允許使用「代表性取樣點」，但必須：
blocks.en: Some POUs cannot be sampled once installed (for example, a filling station with a closed-connection single-use container). ISPE allows the use of a "representative sampling point", but you must:

blocks.zh: 在PQ開始前確立替代取樣點的理由（不能事後補文件）
blocks.en: Establish the rationale for the alternative sampling point before PQ starts (documents cannot be added retrospectively)

blocks.zh: 書面記錄替代點與實際POU的關係（距離、管路構型）
blocks.en: Document the relationship between the alternative point and the actual POU (distance, piping configuration)

blocks.zh: 如果可以，在初始安裝時對實際POU取樣一次，與替代點數據做比對確認
blocks.en: If possible, sample the actual POU once at initial installation and compare with the data from the alternative point to confirm

blocks.zh: 您工廠的一個WFI用水點用於「生理食鹽水配製」和「生產線設備預清洗」（同一個閥門）。這個點應分類為CUP還是NCUP？如何在取樣計畫中處理這個「雙重用途」點？
blocks.en: One WFI point of use in your facility is used for "saline solution preparation" and for "pre-wash of production line equipment" (the same valve). Should this point be classified as CUP or NCUP? How would you handle this "dual-use" point in the sampling plan?

blocks.zh: 在線TOC監測器在PQ延長期被用於日常放行決策。如果等效性驗證是在PQ初始期完成的，這個驗證需要多久重新確認一次？觸發重新驗證的條件是什麼？
blocks.en: An on-line TOC monitor is used for routine release decisions in the PQ extended phase. If the equivalence verification was completed in the PQ initial phase, how often does this verification need to be reconfirmed? What conditions trigger revalidation?

blocks.zh: 設計一個「微生物鑑定決策樹」，說明在PW系統PQ中，哪些情況需要鑑定到種，哪些可以免除。
blocks.en: Design a "microbial identification decision tree" that explains which situations in PW system PQ require identification to species level and which can be exempted.

blocks.zh: 確效報告撰寫與年度定期評估
blocks.en: Writing Validation Reports and Annual Periodic Review

blocks.zh: 中文解說：PQ報告的結構與年度評估
blocks.en: Commentary: Structure of PQ Reports and the Annual Review

blocks.zh: 兩份必須的PQ報告
blocks.en: Two Required PQ Reports

blocks.zh: 中間期總結報告（結束中間期後）：核心輸出是「延長期取樣計畫的建議」——哪些點位、哪些屬性、什麼頻率。這份報告是從中間期「畢業」的入場券。
blocks.en: Intermediate phase summary report (after the intermediate phase ends): the core output is the "recommendation for the extended-phase sampling plan" — which points, which attributes, what frequency. This report is the ticket for "graduating" from the intermediate phase.

blocks.zh: 最終PQ報告（完成全部取樣後）：面向更廣泛的受眾（QA、生產、未來使用者）。不僅是數據彙整，還應包含對日常操作SOP的建議。
blocks.en: Final PQ report (after all sampling is complete): addressed to a wider audience (QA, production, future users). It is not just a data compilation; it should also include recommendations for routine operating SOPs.

blocks.zh: 年度PSE：取樣頻率的動態調整機制
blocks.en: Annual PSE: A Mechanism for Dynamic Adjustment of Sampling Frequency

blocks.zh: PQ結束後，取樣頻率並非固定不變。每年至少一次的PSE（Periodic System Evaluation）提供了數據驅動的頻率調整機會：
blocks.en: After PQ ends, sampling frequency is not fixed. The PSE (Periodic System Evaluation), performed at least once a year, provides a data-driven opportunity to adjust frequency:

blocks.zh: 如果過去一年數據全部遠低於Alert Level → 可考慮降低頻率
blocks.en: If all data over the past year are well below the Alert Level → consider reducing the frequency

blocks.zh: 如果出現季節性微生物上升趨勢 → 夏季加密取樣
blocks.en: If a seasonal rise in microbial counts appears → increase sampling in summer

blocks.zh: 如果Alert Level被觸發次數增加 → 提高頻率或重新評估限度
blocks.en: If the number of Alert Level triggers increases → raise the frequency or reassess the limits

blocks.zh: PSE是ISPE框架中「持續改進」的核心工具。
blocks.en: The PSE is the core tool for "continual improvement" in the ISPE framework.

blocks.zh: 比喻：PSE就像年度健康檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: The PSE is Like an Annual Health Check

blocks.zh: 你不會每天做心電圖，但每年做一次全身健康檢查，根據結果調整生活習慣（即取樣頻率）。如果去年發現血糖偏高，今年就要更頻繁監控。PSE就是水系統的「年度健檢」。
blocks.en: You do not take an ECG every day, but you have a full health check once a year and adjust your lifestyle (i.e. sampling frequency) according to the results. If your blood sugar was high last year, you need to monitor it more often this year. The PSE is the "annual health check" of the water system.

blocks.zh: CDMO情境：最終PQ報告的典型章節結構
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Typical Chapter Structure of a Final PQ Report

blocks.zh: 目的與範圍
blocks.en: Purpose and scope

blocks.zh: 系統描述（PID、用水點清單、設備清單）
blocks.en: System description (P&ID, list of points of use, equipment list)

blocks.zh: 取樣計畫摘要（依階段）
blocks.en: Sampling plan summary (by phase)

blocks.zh: 數據彙整與統計分析
blocks.en: Data compilation and statistical analysis

blocks.zh: 偏差與OOS事件摘要
blocks.en: Summary of deviations and OOS events

blocks.zh: 季節性趨勢觀察
blocks.en: Observations on seasonal trends

blocks.zh: Alert/Action Level適當性評估
blocks.en: Assessment of the suitability of Alert/Action Levels

blocks.zh: 日常監測頻率建議（PSE輸入）
blocks.en: Recommended routine monitoring frequency (PSE input)

blocks.zh: 對SOP/操作規程的建議
blocks.en: Recommendations for SOPs/operating procedures

blocks.zh: 結論與核准
blocks.en: Conclusion and approval

blocks.zh: 您的WFI系統完成了12個月PQ，延長期數據顯示所有CUP的微生物結果均低於Alert Level的30%。您能否在PSE中建議將CUP微生物取樣從每週降至每兩週？需要哪些支持文件？
blocks.en: Your WFI system has completed 12 months of PQ, and the extended-phase data show that the microbial results of all CUPs are below 30% of the Alert Level. Can you recommend in the PSE that CUP microbial sampling be reduced from weekly to every two weeks? What supporting documents are needed?

blocks.zh: 中間期總結報告應在什麼時間節點提交？如果報告延遲了3週才完成，對延長期的啟動有什麼影響？
blocks.en: By when should the intermediate phase summary report be submitted? If the report is completed 3 weeks late, what is the impact on starting the extended phase?

blocks.zh: 最終PQ報告「向未來使用者提供有用的操作資訊」這個要求意味著什麼？試舉出兩個具體的操作建議，可以從PQ數據中得出。
blocks.en: What does the requirement that the final PQ report "provide useful operating information to future users" mean? Give two specific operating recommendations that can be drawn from PQ data.

blocks.zh: 合約製造廠QC實驗室規劃：將取樣頻率表轉化為日常運作
blocks.en: Contract Manufacturer QC Laboratory Planning: Turning the Sampling Frequency Tables into Daily Operations

blocks.zh: 中文彙整：CDMO導入要點
blocks.en: Summary: Key Points for CDMO Implementation

blocks.zh: 本節核心訊息 Key Message
blocks.en: Key Message

blocks.zh: 表2.2、2.3、2.4是整份ISPE取樣指南的操作核心——它們將PQ框架轉化為具體、可執行的測試時程表。
blocks.en: Tables 2.2, 2.3 and 2.4 are the operational core of the whole ISPE sampling guide: they turn the PQ framework into concrete, executable test schedules.

blocks.zh: 這三張表告訴我們的不是原則，而是具體動作：在哪裡取樣、測什麼、多久一次。QC實驗室、驗證團隊、QA部門應以這三張表為基礎，建立水系統PQ的操作計畫。
blocks.en: These three tables give us not principles but specific actions: where to sample, what to test, and how often. QC laboratories, validation teams and QA departments should use these three tables as the basis for the operating plan for water system PQ.

blocks.zh: CDMO建立PQ取樣計畫的五步驟
blocks.en: Five Steps for a CDMO to Build a PQ Sampling Plan

blocks.zh: 系統盤點：列出所有取樣點（前處理設備 + 配送迴路用水點），分類CUP/NCUP
blocks.en: System inventory: list all sampling points (pretreatment equipment + distribution loop points of use) and classify them as CUP/NCUP

blocks.zh: 風險評估：對每個點進行風險評分，決定屬於哪個頻率層級
blocks.en: Risk assessment: score the risk of each point and decide which frequency tier it belongs to

blocks.zh: 頻率矩陣：建立「取樣點 × 屬性 × 四個PQ階段」的頻率矩陣（直接對應表2.2-2.4）
blocks.en: Frequency matrix: build a "sampling point × attribute × four PQ phases" frequency matrix (directly corresponding to Tables 2.2-2.4)

blocks.zh: 實驗室能量評估：根據初始期的每日樣品數，確認QC實驗室的容量（人員、設備、試劑）
blocks.en: Laboratory capacity assessment: based on the number of daily samples in the initial phase, confirm the capacity of the QC laboratory (staff, equipment, reagents)

blocks.zh: SOP建立：為每個取樣點建立採樣SOP（包含採樣方法、容器、保存條件、運送時間）
blocks.en: SOP development: create a sampling SOP for each sampling point (including sampling method, container, storage conditions, transport time)

blocks.zh: 常見稽查缺失：頻率未依數據調整
blocks.en: Common Audit Finding: Frequency Not Adjusted Based on Data

blocks.zh: 稽查中最常見的缺失之一：延長期的取樣頻率與中間期完全相同，沒有任何調整，也沒有書面說明「為什麼不調整」。
blocks.en: One of the most common audit findings: the extended-phase sampling frequency is exactly the same as in the intermediate phase, with no adjustment and no written explanation of "why it was not adjusted".

blocks.zh: 正確做法：每次PSE後，都應有書面決策記錄：「根據過去12個月的數據趨勢分析，決定維持/降低/提高目前取樣頻率，理由如下……」
blocks.en: Correct practice: after every PSE, there should be a documented decision record: "Based on trend analysis of the past 12 months of data, it was decided to maintain/reduce/increase the current sampling frequency, for the following reasons ..."

blocks.zh: 快速計算：最小合規WFI取樣樣品數
blocks.en: Quick Calculation: Minimum Compliant Number of WFI Samples

blocks.zh: 以延長期為例（FDA Note B要求）：
blocks.en: Taking the extended phase as an example (FDA Note B requirements):

blocks.zh:
設定：10個WFI POU（4個CUP，6個NCUP）

每日最低要求：
  - 至少1個POU取樣（FDA Note B）
  - CUP: 每週至少一次（10個點中的4個CUP）

每週最低要求：
  - 所有10個POU至少取樣一次（FDA Note B）
  - 分散在7天中：例如每天取樣1-2個點輪換

計算：每月最少取樣點次 ≈
  - CUP（4個）× 每週 × 4週 = 16次
  - NCUP（6個）× 每月 × 1次 = 6次
  - 每日最低（至少1 POU/day）× 30天 = 30次
  - 去重後：每月至少約30-40個WFI POU樣品
blocks.en:
Setup: 10 WFI POUs (4 CUPs, 6 NCUPs)

Minimum daily requirement:
  - At least 1 POU sampled (FDA Note B)
  - CUP: at least once a week (4 CUPs among the 10 points)

Minimum weekly requirement:
  - All 10 POUs sampled at least once (FDA Note B)
  - Spread over 7 days: e.g. rotate 1-2 points per day

Calculation: minimum sampling point-instances per month ≈
  - CUP (4) × weekly × 4 weeks = 16
  - NCUP (6) × monthly × 1 = 6
  - Daily minimum (at least 1 POU/day) × 30 days = 30
  - After removing overlap: at least about 30-40 WFI POU samples per month

blocks.zh: 最終整合練習 Final Integration Questions
blocks.en: Final Integration Questions

blocks.zh: 情境題：您被委任設計一套新建WFI系統（8個POU：3個直接產品接觸、3個設備最終淋洗、2個清潔劑配製）的PQ取樣計畫。請寫出：(a) CUP/NCUP分類，(b) 初始期每日樣品清單，(c) 延長期週頻率分配表。
blocks.en: Scenario question: You are assigned to design the PQ sampling plan for a newly built WFI system (8 POUs: 3 direct product contact, 3 equipment final rinse, 2 detergent preparation). Write out: (a) the CUP/NCUP classification, (b) the daily sample list for the initial phase, (c) the weekly frequency allocation table for the extended phase.

blocks.zh: 比較題：為什麼表2.3（PW）的非關鍵用水點在延長期可以降至每月一次，而表2.4（WFI）的非關鍵用水點理論上也可以每月一次，但實務上很少這樣做？說明原因。
blocks.en: Comparison question: Why can non-critical points of use in Table 2.3 (PW) be reduced to once a month in the extended phase, while non-critical points of use in Table 2.4 (WFI) could in theory also be monthly but rarely are in practice? Explain the reasons.

blocks.zh: 應用題：如果您要向公司管理層說明「為什麼PQ初始期的QC工作量比平時多三倍」，您如何用表2.2到2.4的數字支持您的論點？
blocks.en: Application question: If you need to explain to company management "why the QC workload in the PQ initial phase is three times higher than usual", how would you support your argument with the numbers in Tables 2.2 to 2.4?

blocks.zh: Section Key Message 本節核心訊息
blocks.en: Section Key Message

blocks.zh: 表2.2、2.3、2.4是本指南的操作核心——將風險框架轉化為可執行的逐屬性、逐階段測試時程表。掌握這三張表，等於掌握了設計合規PQ取樣計畫的完整能力。
blocks.en: Tables 2.2, 2.3 and 2.4 are the operational core of this guide: they turn the risk framework into executable, attribute-by-attribute and phase-by-phase test schedules. Mastering these three tables means mastering the full capability to design a compliant PQ sampling plan.
